att.label: Attendance
att.desc: % of raids attended. Every missed raid counts here, excused or not — marking out protects you from strikes, not from attendance.

ten.label: Tenure
ten.desc: Weeks in guild, capped at 4. Full veteran standing in the first month of the phase.

ua.label: Unexcused Absence
ua.desc: Escalating penalty per no-show without notice: 1st = −25, 2nd = −75 total, 3rd = −150 total. Excused absences never count as strikes — but they still lower attendance. Attending 4 consecutive raids clears one strike (officers decrement the counter manually).

blp.label: Bad Luck Protection
blp.desc: Each lost tie /roll-off lifts the player's future scores. Losing to a higher bid never counts — only dice losses do.
